newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian palm oil seen extending rebound.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian palm oil seen extending rebound.

text.p: Palm oil prices in Malaysia were expected to extend their rebound on Friday following overnight gains in Chicago soyoil futures, traders said.
* Aug resistance pegged at 1,210 ringgit a tonne
* Aug closed on Thursday at 1,198 ringgit
* Prices seen helped by Egypt's purchase of 10,000 tonnes of RBD palm oil and 10,000 tonnes of palm stearin
* Market players awaiting crop report for May from private crop forecaster Ivan Wong, expected later on Friday
